_doc: Superstore Saga: Act I Story Graph. An uplifting, high-energy, positive orientation shift across all four department tracks.

nodes.text: Welcome to the MegaMart family! We are thrilled to welcome you to Complex #1042! Our onboarding portal is designed to discover your natural talents so we can place you right where you'll shine brightest. Three quick scenario questions—just go with your gut instincts and let's have fun with it!

choices.text: Begin the pre-employment orientation assessment.

nodes.text: Scenario 1: You're on the sales floor and notice a customer looking a bit turned around in the aisles, while another shopper has a question about prices. How do you tackle the moment?

choices.text: Offer a warm smile, personally walk the first customer to their item, and radio an associate to assist the second!
Direct both with a friendly wave and a clear aisle pointer so everyone stays moving fast!
Call out a cheerful 'Welcome to MegaMart!' and turn it into a fun, welcoming moment for the whole aisle!

nodes.text: Scenario 2: It's a bustling Saturday morning, upbeat music is playing over the loudspeakers, and the store is humming with energy. What gets you most pumped?

choices.text: The team energy! Collaborating with my department to smash our morning goals!
Finding that smooth, steady groove where the work is satisfying and the hours just fly by!
Solving tricky customer requests and seeing their faces light up when they find exactly what they need!

nodes.text: Final scenario! Store Manager Henderson announces a friendly department challenge for the best presentation and highest customer feedback score. How do you step up?

choices.text: Give 110% on every single shelf and make our department look like a magazine cover!
Keep team spirits high and make sure we all support each other through the rush!
Lead a friendly cross-department rivalry—a little healthy competition makes everyone better!

nodes.text: Sensational! The algorithm indicates exceptional retail potential! Compatibility score: a stellar 98.4%! Here is your brand-new badge, Associate #1042! Now, where does your retail journey begin?

choices.text: Front End Cashier: Fast hands, warm smiles, and front-line energy!
Sales Floor Stocker: Dynamic action, building impressive displays, and keeping aisles pristine!
Backroom Receiving: High energy, heavy freight, and powering the store's heartbeat!
Specialty Counter: Expert advice, cutting-edge tech, and high-value customer service!

nodes.text: Welcome aboard, rookie! Locker 42 is all yours—freshly polished and ready. Your navy vest is hanging inside. That new-badge shine looks good on you!
Hey there! Ready to run the registers? It's a fantastic feeling once you catch that barcode rhythm. You and me are going to keep Lane Four moving like clockwork!
Good morning, team! Opening registers are all prepped, till drawers are balanced, and receipt rolls are stocked. Today is going to be an awesome shift!
Welcome to the sales floor, recruit! Locker 42 is yours. You're going to love this crew—everyone looks out for each other out there in the aisles.
Welcome to the team, rookie! Our grocery displays are the showpiece of Store #1042. You and Kyle are going to make Action Alley look like a grand opening today!
Hey, great to meet you! I'll show you the smoothest way to face shelves and make the aisles pop. We're gonna crush our morning goals together.
Backroom freight crew! That's the engine room of the whole store. Locker 42 is yours—steel-toes ready, vest zipped, let's make it happen!
Welcome to Receiving! Best workout in the state, and the tightest team in the building. We unload fast, keep each other safe, and have a blast doing it.
Crown Three is freshly charged and inspected. Stick with us, rookie, and you'll be navigating the pallet line like a seasoned pro by lunchtime.
Specialty desk! That's where all the exciting gadgets live. Locker 42 is yours, and here's the shiny department key ring—handle with pride!
Welcome to Specialty, associate! Our counter is where customers come when they want real advice from knowledgeable experts. You're going to do great.
Hey, welcome to the floor! Tech and electronics have the best energy in the whole store. Let's get out there and help folks find some amazing gear today.
You've got three minutes before Henderson climbs his milk crate in Action Alley. What's on your mind before we head out to the huddle?

choices.text: Donna, what's your best advice for making Day One a huge success?
How long have you been at Store #1042? Those 30+ service pins look legendary.
Time to head to Action Alley for the morning huddle!

nodes.text: Three golden rules from fifteen years at #1042: First, wear comfortable shoes—you'll get a great workout before lunch! Second, keep a warm smile—a positive attitude is contagious on the sales floor. And third, Store Manager Henderson has huge passion for our team—he gets really hyped up during the store cheer, so bring that enthusiasm and you'll shine!

Fifteen years, and every single pin represents a great holiday season, a big community drive, or a team that pulled together to do something special. MegaMart has a lot of heart when everyone pulls in the same direction. Keep your spirits high, do your best, and you'll love it here.

Good morning, Complex #1042! Look at this incredible energy! Smell that fresh freight! Today is Regional Efficiency Benchmark Day, and I told District VP Vance that our store has the most dedicated, customer-focused team in the entire company! Let's show the region what #1042 can do! GIVE ME AN M! GIVE ME AN E!

choices.text: Yell with 100% team pride: 'E! WOOOO! LET'S GO #1042!'
Cheer with a bright, confident smile: 'E! Let's do this!'
Raise your coffee mug with a warm grin: 'Here's to an awesome shift and a record-breaking day!'

nodes.text: YES! THAT'S WHAT I'M TALKING ABOUT! Pure #1042 passion right there! Look at our new hire lighting up the room! Team, let's take that championship energy right to the floor!
That's the spirit! Steady, confident, and ready to serve! With teamwork like this, today is going to be our highest-rated shift of the month!
I love it! Fuel up, lock in, and bring that optimism to every customer! A happy associate makes a happy customer!
All right, all-stars! Registers are shining, shelves are sparkling, docks are rolling! Let's get out there and make today unforgettable! Break out to your stations!

choices.text: Report to Front End Register Lane 4 with Marsha.
Report to Center Grocery Aisles with Todd.
Report to Backroom Receiving Bay 2 with Mack.
Report to the Specialty Tech Counter with Julian.

nodes.text: Here's your U-boat cart, rookie! Cereal aisle is our showcase aisle this morning. Let's get these displays looking immaculate before the opening crowd floods in!

choices.text: Face every cereal box with pinpoint precision for a showroom finish!
Work side-by-side with Kyle, learning his favorite stacking shortcuts.

nodes.text: Trailer door is up! The roller line is moving smooth and steady. Let's show the morning shift how cleanly Bay Two clears freight!

choices.text: Catch your stride on the conveyor line, sorting cartons with effortless flow.
Team up with Derrick to maneuver the heavy pallet stacks with safety and precision.

nodes.text: Key in hand, associate! Our first tech customer is browsing the premium display. Let's greet them with genuine excitement and find the perfect match for their setup!

choices.text: Share expert insights on the latest gear and outline the peace-of-mind protection plan.
Help them pick out the exact cable they need and show them the demo display.

nodes.text: TEAM RALLY AT THE FRONT! We have an amazing rush of morning shoppers in the concourse! Register Four is open, the lines are lively, and everyone is excited to check out! Let's assemble and give them five-star service!

Spectacular job on your very first rush, rookie! You handled those scanner beeps and coupon questions like a natural. Henderson already noticed our wait times were the lowest in the district! Punch out on the scanner and enjoy that well-earned break—you've earned your stripes today!
Orientation shift concluded with flying colors! Your badge is officially active in the employee chronicle. You conquered Shift 1 of 56 at MegaMart Store #1042!
